UNDERSTAND YOUR OPTIONS

Plumbing Repairs

01

Describe the change

Sudden or gradual? One fixture or several? Pressure, noise, temperature, and moisture help narrow investigation.

02

Connections, pipes, and fixtures

Repair may involve a valve, fitting, pipe, or fixture component. Understand the affected part and proposed work before proceeding.

03

When it cannot wait

Active flooding, uncontrolled leaks, and wastewater backups warrant a call. Stop using affected fixtures and avoid water near electrical equipment.

SERVICE QUESTIONS

Good questions. Useful answers.

Can I send photos before a visit?+

Call or email photos of accessible areas. Do not dismantle equipment or enter unsafe areas for photographs.

What should I report about low pressure?+

Note whether it affects hot, cold, or both and whether other fixtures have the issue.
